description: Public quoted hotel pricing context used to estimate room-comp opportunity cost and market pressure. These fields are not internal ADR, occupancy, inventory, revenue, contribution margin, or comp policy.
row_grain: one public pricing context row per stay date
public_safety_rule: Reports may describe these fields as public quoted-rate context or sample-seed quote context only. They must not be described as actual Proper Hotels rates, occupancy, room inventory, revenue, margin, or historical comp data.
decision_use: increase opportunity-cost penalty for room upgrades during high public rate pressure
increase refund cost pressure for direct room refunds during high public rate pressure
support manager explanations for why lower-margin hospitality gestures may be preferred
